enums.name: poDesigned
enums.comment: use bounds from the designer (read from stream)

enums.name: poScreenCenter
enums.comment: center form on screen (depends on DefaultMonitor)

enums.name: poDesktopCenter
enums.comment: center form on desktop (total of all screens)

enums.name: poMainFormCenter
enums.comment: center form on main form (depends on DefaultMonitor)

enums.name: poOwnerFormCenter
enums.comment: center form on owner form (depends on DefaultMonitor)

enums.name: poWorkAreaCenter
enums.comment: center form on working area (depends on DefaultMonitor)

enums.name: csDropDown
enums.comment: like an TEdit plus a button to drop down the list, default

enums.name: csSimple
enums.comment: like an TEdit plus a TListBox

enums.name: csDropDownList
enums.comment: like TLabel plus a button to drop down the list

enums.name: csOwnerDrawVariable
enums.comment: like csDropDownList, but custom drawn and with each item can have another height

enums.name: bsExclusive
enums.comment: button is the only down in his group

enums.name: nsBound
enums.comment: bound to a tree, e.g. has Parent or is top lvl node

enums.name: naAdd
enums.comment: add as last sibling of Destination

enums.name: naAddFirst
enums.comment: add as first sibling of Destination

enums.name: naAddChild
enums.comment: add as last child of Destination

enums.name: naAddChildFirst
enums.comment: add as first child of Destination

enums.name: tbsCheck
enums.comment: check item (click to toggle state, can be grouped)

enums.name: tbsDropDown
enums.comment: button with dropdown button to show a popup menu

enums.name: tbsButtonDrop
enums.comment: button with arrow (not separated from each other)

enums.name: ofOverwritePrompt
enums.comment: if selected file exists shows a message, that file

enums.name: ofPathMustExist
enums.comment: shows an error message if selected path does not exist

enums.name: ofFileMustExist
enums.comment: shows an error message if selected file does not exist

enums.name: ofNoReadOnlyReturn
enums.comment: do not return filenames that are readonly

enums.name: ofNoDereferenceLinks
enums.comment: do not resolve links while dialog is shown (only on Windows, see OFN_NODEREFERENCELINKS)

enums.name: ofNoResolveLinks
enums.comment: do not resolve links after Execute

enums.name: ofEnableSizing
enums.comment: dialog can be resized, e.g. via the mouse

enums.name: ofDontAddToRecent
enums.comment: do not add the path to the history list

enums.name: ofViewDetail
enums.comment: details are OS and interface dependent

enums.name: ofAutoPreview
enums.comment: details are OS and interface dependent

enums.name: goRelaxedRowSelect
enums.comment: User can see focused cell on goRowSelect

enums.name: goDblClickAutoSize
enums.comment: dblclicking columns borders (on hdrs) resize col.

enums.name: goSmoothScroll
enums.comment: Switch scrolling mode (pixel scroll is by default)

enums.name: goScrollKeepVisible
enums.comment: keeps focused cell visible while scrolling

enums.name: goHeaderHotTracking
enums.comment: Header cells change look when mouse is over them

enums.name: goHeaderPushedLook
enums.comment: Header cells looks pushed when clicked

enums.name: goSelectionActive
enums.comment: Setting grid.Selection moves also cell cursor

enums.name: goDontScrollPartCell
enums.comment: clicking partially visible cells will not scroll

enums.name: goTruncCellHints
enums.comment: show cell hints if cell text is too long

enums.name: goCellEllipsis
enums.comment: show "..." if cell text is too long

enums.name: goAutoAddRowsSkipContentCheck
enums.comment: BB Also add a row (if AutoAddRows in Options) if last row is empty

enums.name: csCreating
enums.comment: not used, exists for Delphi compatibility

enums.name: csAcceptsControls
enums.comment: can have children in the designer

enums.name: csDesignInteractive
enums.comment: wants mouse events in design mode

enums.name: csSetCaption
enums.comment: if Name=Caption, changing the Name changes the Caption

enums.name: csOpaque
enums.comment: the control paints its area completely

enums.name: csFixedHeight
enums.comment: cannot change its height (for example combobox)

enums.name: csNoStdEvents
enums.comment: standard events such as mouse, key, and click events are ignored.

enums.name: csDisplayDragImage
enums.comment: display images from dragimagelist during drag operation over control

enums.name: csReflector
enums.comment: not implemented, the controls respond to size, focus and dlg messages - it can be used as ActiveX control under Windows

enums.name: csNoFocus
enums.comment: control will not take focus when clicked with mouse.

enums.name: csParentBackground
enums.comment: tells WinXP to paint the theme background of parent on controls background

enums.name: csDesignNoSmoothResize
enums.comment: when resizing control in the designer do not SetBounds while dragging

enums.name: csDesignFixedBounds
enums.comment: can not be moved nor resized in designer

enums.name: csNoDesignSelectable
enums.comment: can not be selected at design time

enums.name: csOwnedChildrenNotSelectable
enums.comment: child controls owned by this control are NOT selectable in the designer

enums.name: csAutoSize0x0
enums.comment: if the preferred size is 0x0 then control is shrinked ot 0x0

enums.name: csAutoSizeKeepChildLeft
enums.comment: when AutoSize=true do not move children horizontally

enums.name: csAutoSizeKeepChildTop
enums.comment: when AutoSize=true do not move children vertically

enums.name: csRequiresKeyboardInput
enums.comment: If the device has no physical keyboard then show the virtual keyboard when this control gets focus (therefore available only to TWinControl descendents)

enums.name: stDefault
enums.comment: use default rules for showing taskbar item

enums.name: stAlways
enums.comment: always show taskbar item for the form

enums.name: stNever
enums.comment: never show taskbar item for the form

enums.name: lboDrawFocusRect
enums.comment: draw focus rect in case of owner drawing

enums.name: crsScaleChilds
enums.comment: scale children equally, keep space between children fixed

enums.name: crsHomogenousChildResize
enums.comment: enlarge children equally (i.e. by the same amount of pixel)

enums.name: cclLeftToRightThenTopToBottom
enums.comment: if BiDiMode <> bdLeftToRight then it becomes RightToLeft

enums.name: goScrollToLastCol
enums.comment: allow scrolling to last column (so that last column can be leftcol)

enums.name: goScrollToLastRow
enums.comment: allow scrolling to last row (so that last row can be toprow)

enums.name: lapFixedLayout
enums.comment: A fixed absolute layout in all platforms

enums.name: lapAutoAdjustForDPI
enums.comment: For desktops using High DPI, scale x and y to fit the DPI

enums.name: waAvoid
enums.comment: try not to wrap after this control, if the control is already at the beginning of the row, wrap though
